# Overview

PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC’s data, technology, and marketing teams are actively engaged in pipeline and customer acquisition reporting efforts. These teams coordinate across several established processes to manage, analyze, and report on business pipeline and client acquisition metrics.

The organization’s operational environment features a suite of integrated tools and platforms, including Salesforce, Tamarac, Azure Blob Storage, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Power BI. A Power BI reporting suite currently provides analytics capabilities, drawing data primarily from Salesforce, Tamarac, Azure Blob Storage, and, pending integration, QuickBooks. Microsoft Fabric and Azure Synapse serve as the core data platform infrastructure supporting batch data processing requirements. Integration efforts focus on connecting and ingesting data from QuickBooks, with special attention to assessing data quality for customer acquisition cost (CAC) reporting.
